seg.notes: Four reportable segments (Aggregates, Asphalt, Concrete, Calcium); Calcium still separate in 2020-21. Segment revenues incl. freight & delivery (post-2018 basis); intersegment eliminations are all Aggregates sales. Tons/cubic yards converted from thousands to millions (3 dp). calc_tons/calc_price are extra fields (Calcium tons m, $/ton). Freight-adjusted revenues, freight & delivery and other revenues from Appendix 1 reconciliation; Aggregates cash gross profit as published. Q4/FY columns taken directly from the Q4 release (three- and twelve-month columns); no derivation.

eps_bridge_lines: Items included in Adjusted EBITDA above
ngaap.notes: Vulcan's EBITDA bridge starts at net earnings (2021 Q3+: net earnings attributable to Vulcan) and adds back income tax, interest expense and the loss (earnings) on discontinued operations NET OF TAX before DDA&A, so published EBITDA is continuing-ops EBITDA; the schema check ni_vulcan+ebitda_bridge_tax+interest+total_dda=ebitda_pub therefore differs by ebitda_bridge_disc_ops (extra field, value as added); including it the check ties. adj_items.disc_ops is null (disc ops is not an EBITDA->Adjusted EBITDA item). Adjusted EPS bridge: 'Items included in Adjusted EBITDA above' is the after-tax per-share effect of all EBITDA adjustments. Business development = non-routine acquisition charges incl. purchase-accounting inventory step-up -> adj_items.acquisition; COVID-19 direct incremental costs -> adj_items.other. Q4-20: pension settlement charge 22.7 (non-cash, voluntary lump-sum distribution; booked in other nonoperating expense). ROIC TTM = FY2020 14.3%.
